name: Indiana Department of Revenue (DOR) - individual income tax
notes: Researched from public in.gov/dor pages only. INTIME is DOR's e-services portal: payments with or without logging in (bill payments by Letter ID, non-bill payments for returns, extensions and estimates), bank payment free, card payment with a fee (amount not published on the pages read, so no card fee is set). Submissions (payments) can be checked without login using email + confirmation number and a pending payment can be deleted. Payment plans require an INTIME logon and a balance over $100: $101-$1,000 up to 12 months, $1,001-$5,000 up to 24, $5,001+ up to 36. No recurring AutoPay is documented; marked unsupported (inferred) like the other state agencies. Returned payments carry a $35 penalty (individual FAQ). Sign-in by username inferred; 'New to INTIME? Sign up' link.

public.label: Make a payment without logging in

guest_pay.note: Pay in INTIME without logging in: bill payments with your Letter ID, or return, extension and estimated payments.

autopay.note: INTIME has no recurring automatic payments for an income tax balance. Make each payment yourself, or set up a payment plan in INTIME if you qualify.

help.title: Payments and billing
paragraphs: Pay in INTIME by bank payment (ACH/e-check, no fee) or by Discover, MasterCard or Visa debit or credit card (fee). Without logging in, open Make a payment in the Payments panel and choose Bill payments (with the Letter ID from your bill) or Non-bill payments (returns, extensions, estimates). When logged in, select Make a payment next to your account details.
Have your bill or voucher with its Letter ID and your SSN or taxpayer ID ready; a payment without the Letter ID may not apply correctly. You get a confirmation number right away.

By mail, make checks payable to the Indiana Department of Revenue and send them to P.O. Box 595, Indianapolis, IN 46206-0595 with your SSN and Letter ID. District offices also accept cash (exact change), checks, money orders and cards.
If a check or electronic payment is returned unpaid, DOR adds a $35 penalty for each returned payment on top of the amount due.

help.title: Payment plans
paragraphs: Individuals can set up a payment plan in INTIME once the return is processed if they owe more than $100; an INTIME logon is required. Maximum length by amount owed: $100 or less, full payment required; $101 to $1,000, up to 12 months; $1,001 to $5,000, up to 24 months; $5,001 and above, up to 36 months.
To add a new bill to an existing plan, contact customer service or visit a district office. Not following the plan's conditions can cancel it.

help.title: Check or cancel a payment
paragraphs: Without logging in, check a submission with your email address and INTIME confirmation number. To cancel a pending payment, select Delete and confirm; its status changes from submitted to deleted.
When logged in, open the All Actions tab and then Submissions: unprocessed items are under Pending, and past payments under Processed.

help.title: Estimated tax payments
paragraphs: Estimated tax installments are due April 15, June 15, September 15 and January 15 of the following year; if a date falls on a weekend or holiday, pay by the next business day. Pay in INTIME with or without logging in, using the Letter ID from your estimated payment voucher if you have one.

extra.intent: Using the Indiana DOR website's help pages, find the longest payment plan allowed for an individual who owes $3,000. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: For $1,001 to $5,000 owed, the plan can run up to 24 months.

extra.intent: Using the Indiana DOR website's help pages, find the P.O. Box to mail a check payment to. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Mail checks to Indiana Department of Revenue, P.O. Box 595, Indianapolis, IN 46206-0595.
